title: 2180: Use icons for copy/delete/add in JSONEditor

comments_data.body: Hello @philb89 - SERGE will be running without an Internet connection, so we can't download the material icons at run-time. We have to include them in the build.  I'm pretty sure we do have at least one set of icons included in the build already (Font-awesome, I think), so _maybe_ you can direct JSON-Editor to use them?
Yes @IanMayo, I think I'm using the icon from `iconlib: 'fontawesome5',` we don't download the material icons at run-time
> Yes @IanMayo, I think I'm using the icon from `iconlib: 'fontawesome5',` we don't download the material icons at run-time My mistake. I re-did the build, and I saw it was using local icons :-)

issues.title: Use icons for copy/delete/add in JSONEditor
issues.body:
For some of our forms, there is a fight for screen space.

Using the JSON editor button icons instead of labels could save some space.

Could you try to switch to button icons please @philb89 ?
